name: PT Saturn USD 14JAN2027
reason: Insufficient verified exit evidence for this Monad representation: PT redemption returns SY/Monad USDat, while issuer documentation specifies Ethereum redemption routes. A usable Monad-local or supported cross-chain issuer exit and the associated controls were not established. This is an evidence-based exclusion, not a finding of fraud.
redeem: Pendle documents PT redemption through YT into SY after maturity; before maturity both PT and YT are required, or PT can be sold at an available market price. This PT expires 2027-01-14 00:00:00 UTC. Its SY lists Monad USDat as the sole output token. Ethereum USDat redemption terms do not establish a Monad-to-USDC exit; liquidity, bridge availability and issuer access remain dependencies.
notes: Read-only Monad RPC checks on 2026-11-05 confirmed chain 143, token name/symbol/6 decimals, expiry 1799884800, SY, YT, yieldToken and assetInfo. The official Pendle integration registry matches this exact chain/address and Morpho market. SY owner() returns an address, but its controller composition and upgrade/pausing powers were not independently established. No redemption transaction, bridge quote, reserve attestation or executable exit-liquidity test was performed. Existing descriptive USDat coverage is not an approval of this PT.
